mechanism: Alcohol potentiates glyburide's hypoglycemic effect and impairs hepatic gluconeogenesis, increasing risk of severe hypoglycemia; acute alcohol may inhibit CYP3A4/2C9 metabolism of glyburide.
action: Advise patients to avoid or severely limit alcohol consumption; educate on hypoglycemia symptoms and ensure availability of rapid-acting carbohydrates; monitor blood glucose closely.
